title: PMDG 777-300ER: Marketplace vs Direct Purchase - What Simmers Need to Know
description:
Are you a flight simulation enthusiast looking to add the PMDG 777-300ER to your virtual hangar? ✈️ This video breaks down the key differences between purchasing directly from PMDG and through the MSFS Marketplace. We’ll cover everything from pricing and features to updates and installation processes. By weighing the pros, such as centralized management and exclusive discounts, against the cons, like potential update delays and limited liveries, we provide all the information you need to make an informed decision. 📊 Don’t miss our comprehensive guide—it could save you time and enhance your flying experience! 🕹️
